> **Required package:** [`Dapper.FluentMap.Dommel`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Dapper.FluentMap.Dommel)

## Problem solved

Add table, key, generated-column, and mapped write metadata.

## When to use it

Use this capability when the column shape and .NET model should remain separated by explicit, reviewable configuration.

## Example

```csharp
FluentMapper.Initialize(config =>
{
    config.AddMap<CustomerMap>();
    config.ForDommel();
});
```

## How it works

FluentMap registers typed metadata and applies it through the matching materialization path. SQL, connections, parameters, and lifecycle remain responsibilities of the application and Dapper.

## Constraints

:::caution
Dommel is optional. Historical Dommel Insert/Update cannot apply per-property write converters; use InsertMapped*/UpdateMapped* when conversion is required.
:::
